topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Folks talk of finding old things, treasures from when they were but sprats, and it sets me to thinkin'. There's a fellow in the village, once a little lass, now grown and seen the world, or as much of it as we can from the top of the hill. She found her bear, a stuffed thing, at a sale. Not just any bear, but the one from her youth, the one she cried into and hugged when the night seemed too dark. I reckon it's a bit of magic, finding a piece of your past, all tucked away and forgotten, and there it is, waiting for you to remember it. The world feels a little warmer for that, like the first day the sun breaks through the clouds after a long, grey spell.
